webhooks.detail: Register webhook URL; payload sent on events like new recording processed, recording settings change, clip created. Full event list in developers.grain.com hooks docs.

evidence.quote: Register a webhook URL in your integration and Grain will send a payload to that URL whenever a registered event occurs, for example, a new recording is processed, a recording's settings change, or a clip is created.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox. But personal access tokens available on every plan incl. Free, so free account usable for testing against own workspace. Workspace tokens need Business/Enterprise.

evidence.quote: No sandbox is available at this time.

rate_limits.summary: 300 requests/min per token; 429 beyond; rate limit headers returned

evidence.quote: The API allows 300 requests per minute per token.
A Personal Access Token (PAT) authenticates requests as you, with the same access you have in Grain.
